subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord edit-to-reprocess and source-message delete-to-cancel become default-on bundled Discord plugin behavior, or should maintainers require opt-in or narrower semantics first?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the behavior changes how existing Discord messages own and abort active session work, and the active PR is already carrying that product decision.

options.title: Accept default-on after PR proof
options.body: Land the linked PR after its code defect, tests, and live Discord proof are resolved, without adding a new config surface.

options.title: Require opt-in semantics
options.body: Ask the implementation to add a documented opt-in or narrower policy before any edit/delete behavior affects existing Discord users.

options.title: Defer channel semantics
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation until broader cross-channel recall/edit behavior is decided.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on after PR proof
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after its code defect, tests, and live Discord proof are resolved, without adding a new config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord monitor and queue history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the product-semantics decision.
